messages:
elena: Heads-up — KMS/HSM staging cutover scheduled for tomorrow 06:30 PT. Quick readiness check: owners, smoke tests, perms, and rollback plan? Please reply with current status or blockers.

akshay: I can own the KMS side. Quick checklist: key import verified ✅, IAM bindings staged (still pending approvals), env var fallback needs PR.

tara: HSM side: hardware racked and validated, firmware 1.2.3 installed. Network ACLs mostly ready but waiting for cert to mount. Will need netops to approve staging-subnet ACL.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: reserved deployment window 2026-03-18T13:30Z for staging cutover (locks: infra, kms, hsm).

maria: Can someone run the audit-log smoke test after the PR is merged? Quick command: `curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TEST' "https://staging.redwood/api/audit/logs?limit=5"` — look for events with `source=kms` and `action=import`.

elena: Also note PR #4821 is blocking config fallback — @akshay can you address the env var fallback before cutover? It's a short change.

akshay: on it, will push a patch in ~15m and ping for review.

tara: @joel (netops) can you approve the ACL for mounting HSM on the staging subnet? Need explicit allow for 10.12.32.0/24 -> hsm-cluster.

joel: I checked the rules, ACL looks fine but I'll post the terraform diff and apply window. Approved: rule acl-7865.

maria: :+1: once PR is merged I’ll run the smoke tests and share logs. What’s the rollback plan if we see key failures?

elena: Rollback plan (short): 1) Disable routing to new KMS nodes in the LB, 2) revert `kms-config` ConfigMap to previous commit, 3) re-import previous key variant if needed (we have export snapshot). Full runbook: https://confluence.redwood/runbooks/kms-cutover (staging copy).

tara: We also need to collect HSM attestation output and associated SAML claim logs for SOC2 evidence. @compliance-bot please create an evidence ticket and pin artifacts.

compliance-bot: evidence-bot: created ticket SEC-3141 with checklist: attestation output, audit-log snapshot, key-rotation record. Tracker: https://tracker.redwood/SEC-3141

elena: Thanks — if there are no more blockers, respond with :+1: and I’ll mark ready in the calendar.

akshay: :+1: PR #4821 merged and small env fallback patch deployed to staging.

maria: :+1: smoke tests green — sample entry: `2026-03-17T22:12:03Z kms:import OK event_id=abcd1234` (events returned: 5).

tara: HSM mount cert received and applied, attestation output captured to /evidence/staging/hsm-attestation-2026-03-17.tar.gz.

joel: Terraform diff posted: https://git/redwood/infra/changesets/789 — apply scheduled in the same window.

elena: Awesome, thanks team. Cutover go at 06:30 PT tomorrow. I’ll open a post-cutover validation thread after we start. Closing this readiness thread — keep the tracker updated. :rocket:
